newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude edges up in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude edges up in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude edged up in late U.S. paper trading on Wednesday, traders said.
A full boat of August Brent traded at $18.98 a barrel, up six cents from the IPE close in London.
Three partial August cargoes traded at the same level, while a fourth changed hands at $18.93, traders said.
August/September Brent moved twice at minus three cents, up four cents from a traded earlier in the day.
Activity was subdued heading up to the U.S. Independence Day holiday on Friday.
